title: Glowing treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- glow aura -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="44" ry="30" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.18"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="32" ry="22" fill="#ffd447" opacity="0.25"/>
    <!-- light beams -->
    <polygon points="50,40 30,10 38,12 52,38" fill="#fff3a8" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="50,40 70,8 74,14 54,38" fill="#fff3a8" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="50,40 12,22 16,30 48,42" fill="#ffe98a" opacity="0.45"/>
    <polygon points="50,40 88,24 86,32 54,42" fill="#ffe98a" opacity="0.45"/>
    <!-- chest base -->
    <rect x="22" y="56" width="56" height="30" rx="4" fill="#a8622e"/>
    <rect x="22" y="56" width="56" height="9" rx="4" fill="#c67a3c"/>
    <!-- base shading -->
    <rect x="22" y="78" width="56" height="8" rx="4" fill="#8a4d22"/>
    <!-- lid -->
    <path d="M22 56 Q22 34 50 34 Q78 34 78 56 Z" fill="#b96e34"/>
    <path d="M22 56 Q22 40 50 40 Q78 40 78 56 L72 56 Q72 44 50 44 Q28 44 28 56 Z" fill="#d68a48"/>
    <!-- inner glow gap -->
    <rect x="24" y="54" width="52" height="5" rx="2" fill="#fff5b0"/>
    <!-- straps -->
    <rect x="30" y="34" width="5" height="52" fill="#e8c46a"/>
    <rect x="65" y="34" width="5" height="52" fill="#e8c46a"/>
    <!-- lock -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="6" fill="#ffcf4d"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="60" r="3" fill="#fff3a8"/>
    <rect x="48.5" y="60" width="3" height="6" fill="#ffcf4d"/>
    <!-- gems spilling -->
    <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="6" fill="#fffbd6"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="5" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#fffbd6"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="4" fill="#ffd447"/>
    <!-- sparkles -->
    <g fill="#ffffff">
      <path d="M20 30 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 Z"/>
      <path d="M80 60 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 Z"/>
      <path d="M72 28 l1 2.6 l2.6 1 l-2.6 1 l-1 2.6 l-1 -2.6 l-2.6 -1 l2.6 -1 Z"/>
      <path d="M28 72 l1 2.4 l2.4 1 l-2.4 1 l-1 2.4 l-1 -2.4 l-2.4 -1 l2.4 -1 Z"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
